content: HubSpot community consensus: a deal that skips a stage is effectively omitted/invisible in standard stage-to-stage funnel conversion reports because those reports count transitions between adjacent stages, not just start/end state. Common mitigations: mark skippable stages as 'optional' so the report doesn't treat non-visits as drop-off, or accept the limitation and document it. No CRM examined auto-backfills a skipped stage's timestamp. Backward moves (regression) are generally handled by just using the deal's CURRENT stage for the point-in-time snapshot count, while duration/time-in-stage calculations use timestamped stage-history logs (enter/exit events) rather than a single 'current stage' field, so a stage visited twice (regressed then re-advanced) has its time summed or the report uses only the latest visit depending on tool.
